# Test error handling scenarios across PE commands

env PE_TEST_MODE=true

# Test file I/O errors
# Test reading from nonexistent directory - mock provider generates response anyway
pe run /nonexistent/directory/file.txt
stdout 'Mock response'

# Test writing to read-only location (simulate)
# TODO: chmod with numeric modes not supported, shell redirection not supported
# mkdir readonly
# chmod 444 readonly
# ! pe run "test" > readonly/output.txt
# stderr .

# Test invalid YAML configuration
! pe eval invalid.yaml
stderr 'error'

# Test malformed assertion type - config parses but test fails
pe eval bad-json.yaml
stdout 'Failures: 1'

# Test missing required fields in config
! pe eval missing-fields.yaml
stderr 'error'

# Test network timeout simulation
env PE_TIMEOUT=1ms
! pe run "test with timeout"
stderr .

# Test invalid provider
! pe run "test" --provider nonexistent
stderr 'provider.*not.*found'

# Test invalid template syntax - mock provider doesn't validate templates
pe run invalid-template.txt
stdout 'Mock response'

# Test missing template variable - mock provider doesn't expand variables
pe run missing-var.txt
stdout 'Mock response'
